extra.message: OS command injection via `_os.system('ping -c 1 ' + host)` at line 147. User-controlled `host` parameter from `request.GET.get('host')` is concatenated directly into shell command. An attacker with knowledge of INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN can achieve arbitrary command execution.

Insecure deserialization of pickled data via `pickle.loads(raw)` at line 70. The `raw` data comes from user-controlled `request.body` or `request.GET.get('blob')`. Pickle deserialization can execute arbitrary code.

Code injection via `eval(expr, {'__builtins__': {}}, {'amount': 42, 'fee': 7})` at line 84. User-controlled `expr` parameter from `request.GET.get('expr')` is evaluated. Despite restricting builtins, function constructors like `type` can still be accessed from the expression scope to execute arbitrary code.

Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) at line 181. MongoDB query is constructed from user-controlled `request.body` and passed to `MongoClient(...).ops.records.find_one(query)`. An attacker can query internal MongoDB instances or trigger actions on internal services.

XML External Entities (XXE) vulnerability at lines 163-164. The `lxml.etree.XMLParser` is configured with `load_dtd=True`, `resolve_entities=True`, and `no_network=False`, then parses user-controlled `request.body`. This allows reading local files via external entities or performing SSRF attacks.

Open redirect vulnerability at line 58 in `case_return_lane_152`. The `lane` parameter from `request.GET.get('lane')` or `request.POST.get('lane')` is passed directly to `redirect()` without validation. An attacker can redirect users to malicious external sites.

CORS misconfiguration with credentials and wildcard origin at lines 119-122 in `case_origin_mirror_471`. The `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` is set to the user-controlled `origin` header value (including `*`), and `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` is set to `true`. This allows cross-origin attacks stealing sensitive data.
Security header removal in `case_frame_slip_481` at lines 129-130. `X-XSS-Protection` is set to 0 and `Content-Security-Policy` is set to empty string, disabling browser XSS protections.

cwe: CWE-1004: Sensitive Cookie Without HttpOnly Flag

extra.message: HTTP Header Injection / Cookie injection at line 92 in `case_crumb_lane_295`. The `marker` parameter from `request.GET.get('marker')` is used directly in `response.set_cookie('portal_crumb', marker)` without validation, allowing injection of additional cookie values via Set-Cookie header.

Path traversal vulnerability at lines 136-139 in `case_dock_shelf_499`. User-controlled `name` parameter from `request.GET.get('name')` is used in `BASE_EXPORT_DIR / name` and then `target.write_bytes(request.body)` writes user data to disk. Attackers can write files to arbitrary locations via paths like `../../../etc/cron.d/malicious`.

Sensitive data exposure at line 550 in `integrations` view. After API key creation, the full key value is displayed to the user in the success message: `f'API key created. Copy now: {key.key}'`. API keys should only be shown once at creation time and never displayed again.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

extra.message: Sensitive data logging at line 77 in `case_wire_tally_217`. The request body and `authorization` header are logged via `logger.warning('ops tally body=%s bearer=%s', body, request.headers.get('authorization'))`. Authorization headers should never be logged as they may contain credentials or tokens.

cwe: CWE-532: Information Exposure Through Log Files

extra.message: Hardcoded credentials at line 18. The demo password 'DemoPass123!' is hardcoded and used for all demo user accounts. If this code is used in production or the password is not changed, it poses a critical security risk.

SSL certificate verification bypass at lines 189-190 in `case_trust_drift_551`. `ssl._create_unverified_context()` is used, disabling SSL certificate verification when making outbound HTTPS requests. This allows man-in-the-middle attacks to intercept sensitive data.

Missing authorization on `case_matter_file_048` endpoint at line 50. The `_wrk_gate` check is NOT performed, unlike all other case_operations functions. This means any user (even without the internal ops token) can access this endpoint to query case information.
